tekst: Council consensus: the disturbance began on day 10 at 04:45 and recurred on a four-day rhythm through day 42, the latest observed incident day. The only recorded intervention before onset is the separate hulpslag pulse, activated on day 10 at 02:40 and boosted at 03:00, under an approval attributed to 'hogerhand' with no named authorizer. Resolved disputes: no cable change occurred (ENG-003, HIS-014, BEA-115), the conjunction theory is rejected because heavy nights began before the stars converged (ORA-112, ORA-110), and no outside breach is evidenced because seals were intact after inside openings (GUA-044, GUA-105). Timestamp errors in the Historian register contradict its own rule and must be checked against originals. Recovery sequence: preserve and copy records, verify timestamps, deactivate the hulpslag, shut down the datanet on Archmage advice, reverse the day 24 pols change, identify the authorizer, extend shield patrols into the 03:00 to 06:00 window, and measure leylijnen on each incident date. Forecast: next recurrence on day 46 if unaddressed.
